name: Iridescent King

description.content: Survivors with [Madness] suffer from the [Afflictions] of Calm, Discipline, Order, and Restraint:

items: They hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius, intermittently in [Madness II] and constantly in [Madness III].

While in a chase, they perceive an illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius as though you were directly behind them. This persists for [6s] after the chase ends in [Madness II], and is constantly active in [Madness III].
Broken Pallets may appear replaced by illusionary Pallets that persist until approached. A new one appears at a random broken Pallet every [20s].
Increases the duration of illusionary Doctor hallucinations by [6s].

description.content: You can see illusionary Red Stains, as well as the Auras of illusionary Doctors and illusionary Pallets.

quote: "Gazing into the iridescent glass is plunging one's self into madness." -Unsigned Notes
